limits: D1 adapter contract tests in one Node process; not native Cloudflare Workers or distributed D1 execution.
Concurrent API calls and atomic SQLite transactions are exercised locally; distributed isolate races are not established.
No external Google network requests, production signup/login, Workers CPU-limit checks, browser, or microphone tests.
